en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a horse‑drawn stagecoach loaded with passengers in front of rustic wooden buildings and palm trees, set against a mountainous backdrop. The coach side reads "MATILIJA HOT SPRINGS" and the lower margin of the postcard states "Matilija Hot Springs, Cal." Vertical text on the left says it was printed in Germany and hand colored, and on the right credits publisher M. Rieder of Los Angeles, California. A red number "5670" is printed in the lower right corner.
